thread:
jane_marketing: Heads-up — product plans to flip adaptive-batching tomorrow. We need final changelog, public docs URL, verified benchmark blurb (include p99), and a firm announce time. Can eng confirm timeline and any risks? :wave:

sam_engineering: Finalizing changelog now, will paste commit link in 10m. Quick changelog lines: - adaptive batching: improves throughput for small/short requests; - KV cache reuse reduces token spend; - no client API changes. Docs currently staged: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-batching (feature-flagged).

nate_content: For the blog and tweet thread we need: short methods note, p50/p99 latency, and cost delta per 1k tokens for the benchmark. Also let's pencil a webinar 2 weeks out — will coordinate dates after launch.

alina_prod: Ops preference: soft-public docs first, then public announcement after canary is green. Messaging guidance: "Same API, lower cost" + fallback path. Avoid absolute %s without context — include workload details.

sam_engineering: Bench highlights (internal suite, chat workload, 512 context, batch=16): p50 120ms, p99 440ms, token-cost delta ~20% (depends on prompt length). Bench notebook: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/bench/abatch-17903. Will add a one-paragraph methods blurb.

cam_ops: Canary window tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT: plan 10% -> 50% @11:00 -> 100% by 11:40 if metrics look good. Rollback toggle ready. We'll post live status and any anomalies here.

jane_marketing: Can marketing take an embargo until 12:10 PT? If canary is green we'll announce at 12:15 PT to give time for final QA on images/email. @nate_content draft 2 headline options and subject line variants.

grace_sales: For inbound routing: please tag early demo leads with `adaptive-batching-interest` and route to sales+solutions. I'll prep a short playbook for qualifying requests.

sam_engineering: Methods blurb: "Benchmarks run on p4d instances comparing continuous batching enabled vs a non-batched baseline. Workloads simulated chat-like prompts with 512 token context." Changelog commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/b7e4f9c

cam_ops: Canary reached 100% at 11:38 PT, docs flipped public at 12:02 PT. No regressions detected; rollback not required.

jane_marketing: Announce scheduled for 12:15 PT. Marketing queued blog, release note, social, and email. Sending embargo lift to comms. :rocket:
